description: Per-repo Renovate config, processed by a self-hosted Renovate runner (the repo must also be listed in that runner's repositories).
chore(deps) commits keep dependency bumps out of the release-please changelog.

customManagers tracks each GitHub-hosted hook repo's rev in prek.toml against its tags: Renovate's built-in pre-commit manager only reads .pre-commit-config.yaml, so prek.toml pins would otherwise go stale silently.

Renovate runs daily and may open PRs on any run. prHourlyLimit is 0 because a run lasts minutes: the preset's 2/hour cap meant about 2 new PRs per run and a months-long queue. prConcurrentLimit still bounds how many are open at once.

Non-major updates automerge through GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass, after minimumReleaseAge holds each release for 3 days. Updates with no release timestamp skip that hold (minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour timestamp-optional): Renovate has none for digest updates, which is how the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions tracking a major tag update, and the default timestamp-required would hold those forever. Major updates and the Python runtime never automerge.
Groups keep related bumps in one PR: prek, prek-action and every prek.toml hook rev move together; GitHub Actions non-major updates are batched.

customManagers.description: prek.toml hook repo revs (each `repo = "https://github.com/..."` line followed directly by its `rev = ...` line)

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once the required checks pass

The Python runtime is upgraded deliberately and never automerged: a python 3.x minor is a language upgrade. matchDepNames, not matchPackageNames: the package names are python/cpython and actions/python-versions
prek tooling: every hook rev in prek.toml moves together
prek tooling: the prek CLI (mise.toml) and its GitHub Action join the hook revs
Batch GitHub Actions non-major and digest updates into one PR (prek-action stays in prek tooling; the python-version runtime pin is excluded)
